requirement: Performance envelope. Agree source count, location contexts, variants, observations, concurrent users and query workload before setting targets.

requirement: Service targets. Negotiate measurable dashboard, API, ingestion, alert and recovery targets with exclusions disclosed.
acceptance_criterion: Every SLA has a measurement window, percentile, owner and breach remedy.

requirement: Cost transparency. Itemize source-context onboarding, refresh, history, storage, egress, matching, support and custom analytics.
acceptance_criterion: A daily-versus-weekly quote states location, country, channel and source-count assumptions.

requirement: No silent truncation. Prohibit undisclosed SKU, row, query, export or history limits within the contracted envelope.
acceptance_criterion: Oversized datasets fail visibly or paginate fully with accurate record counts.

requirement: Training and adoption. Provide role-based training, glossary, onboarding exercises and named support channels.
acceptance_criterion: Pilot users independently complete search, match review, comparison and export tasks.

requirement: Change management. Publish connector and platform release notes, regression evidence and rollout or rollback procedures.
acceptance_criterion: Breaking changes receive agreed notice and a supported migration path.

requirement: Trial acceptance. Test real Alshaya source contexts and agreed products rather than generic demonstration datasets.
acceptance_criterion: Trial exit requires signed evidence for the mandatory use cases and failure scenarios.

requirement: Operational observability. Monitor collection queues, parser drift, match quality, pipeline delay, query latency and cost.
acceptance_criterion: Alerts distinguish source, ingestion, matching and serving failures with actionable ownership.

requirement: Benefit measurement. Baseline analyst effort and decision cycle time; measure adoption and verified business outcomes.
acceptance_criterion: Savings and uplift are reported against a documented baseline, not assumed from platform usage.
